Summary

PRVDIR01 is a batch program that reads the Provider Master indexed file and extracts all active providers to produce a nightly directory flat file consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs). For each active provider record, it writes key provider attributes — including Medicaid ID, NPI, provider type, risk tier, and name — to the output directory file, and reports the total count of directory rows written upon completion.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed), Sequential File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Provider Directory Extract Initialization - Open the Provider Master file as input source and the Provider Directory flat file as output destination to begin the nightly directory extract process 2: Sequential Provider Record Retrieval - Read through all provider records in the Provider Master file sequentially, one record at a time, until all records have been processed 3: Active Provider Filtering - Evaluate each provider record and select only those providers whose status is marked as Active, excluding inactive or terminated providers from the directory 4: Provider Directory Record Mapping - For each active provider, map the following provider attributes to the directory output record: Medicaid ID, NPI (National Provider Identifier), Provider Type Code, Risk Tier, and Provider Name (first 60 characters) 5: Directory Record Output - Write the mapped active provider information as a formatted record to the nightly Provider Directory flat file that is consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs) 6: Active Provider Count Tracking - Maintain a running count of all active provider records written to the directory file during the extract process 7: Directory Extract Completion Reporting - Upon processing all provider records, report the total number of provider directory rows written to the output file for reconciliation and audit purposes

Datasource Information (2)

Datasource Name Type Usage
PRV-MASTER-FILE VSAM KSDS (Indexed) Input – Sequentially reads all provider master records to identify active providers for directory extraction
DIR-OUT-FILE Sequential File Output – Receives the extracted active provider directory records (Medicaid ID, NPI, type, risk tier, name) for consumption by MCOs

High level flow diagram

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Provider Directory Extract Initialization-L1: ```cobol MOVE 'PRVDIR01' TO WS-PROGRAM-ID OPEN INPUT PRV-MASTER-FILE OPEN OUTPUT DIR-OUT-FILE MOVE 'N' TO WS-END-OF-FILE-FLAG ``` Sequential Provider Record Retrieval-L8: ```cobol READ PRV-MASTER-FILE NEXT RECORD MOVE WS-PRV-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS ``` End-of-File Detection for Provider Master File-L10: ```cobol IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ``` Active Provider Filtering-L13: ```cobol IF PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD PERFORM WRITE-DIR-ROW END-IF ``` Provider Directory Record Mapping-L17: ```cobol MOVE PRV-MEDICAID-ID OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-MEDICAID-ID MOVE PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-NPI MOVE PRV-TYPE-CODE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-TYPE MOVE PRV-RISK-TIER OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-RISK-TIER MOVE PRV-VARIANT OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD (1:60) TO DIR-NAME ``` Provider Name 60-Character Truncation Rule-L21: ```cobol MOVE PRV-VARIANT OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD (1:60) TO DIR-NAME ``` Directory Record Output-L22: ```cobol WRITE DIR-OUT-RECORD ``` Active Provider Count Tracking-L23: ```cobol ADD 1 TO WS-DIR-COUNT ``` Directory Extract Completion Reporting-L6: ```cobol CLOSE PRV-MASTER-FILE DIR-OUT-FILE DISPLAY 'PRVDIR01: DIRECTORY ROWS=' WS-DIR-COUNT STOP RUN ```

1: Provider Directory Extract Initialization

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Identify Nightly Directory Extract Program-L_2: ```cobol MOVE 'PRVDIR01' TO WS-PROGRAM-ID ``` Open Provider Master File as Input Source-L_3: ```cobol OPEN INPUT PRV-MASTER-FILE ``` Open Provider Directory Flat File as Output Destination-L_4: ```cobol OPEN OUTPUT DIR-OUT-FILE ``` Initialize Processing Flags for Extract Run-L_5: ```cobol MOVE 'N' TO WS-END-OF-FILE-FLAG ``` Proceed to Provider Record Retrieval After Successful Initialization-L_6: ```cobol PERFORM EXTRACT-NEXT UNTIL WS-END-OF-FILE ```

2: Sequential Provider Record Retrieval

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Sequential Processing of All Provider Records-L_EXTRACT-NEXT: ```cobol EXTRACT-NEXT. READ PRV-MASTER-FILE NEXT RECORD MOVE WS-PRV-STATUS TO WS-FILE-STATUS ``` End of File Detection to Halt Provider Record Processing-L_EXTRACT-NEXT: ```cobol IF WS-FS-EOF SET WS-END-OF-FILE TO TRUE ``` Continue Processing When Provider Record Is Available-L_EXTRACT-NEXT: ```cobol ELSE IF PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD PERFORM WRITE-DIR-ROW END-IF END-IF ```

3: Active Provider Filtering

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Active Provider Status Filter for Directory Inclusion-L_EXTRACT-NEXT: ```cobol IF PRV-ACTIVE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD PERFORM WRITE-DIR-ROW END-IF ```

4: Provider Directory Record Mapping

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Map Medicaid ID to Provider Directory Record-L1: ```cobol MOVE PRV-MEDICAID-ID OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-MEDICAID-ID ``` Map NPI to Provider Directory Record-L2: ```cobol MOVE PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-NPI ``` Map Provider Type Code to Provider Directory Record-L3: ```cobol MOVE PRV-TYPE-CODE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-TYPE ``` Map Risk Tier to Provider Directory Record-L4: ```cobol MOVE PRV-RISK-TIER OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-RISK-TIER ``` Map Provider Name (First 60 Characters) to Provider Directory Record-L5: ```cobol MOVE PRV-VARIANT OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD (1:60) TO DIR-NAME ```

5: Directory Record Output

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Assemble Provider Directory Output Record with All Mapped Provider Attributes-L_WRITE-DIR-ROW: ```cobol MOVE PRV-MEDICAID-ID OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-MEDICAID-ID MOVE PRV-NPI OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-NPI MOVE PRV-TYPE-CODE OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-TYPE MOVE PRV-RISK-TIER OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD TO DIR-RISK-TIER MOVE PRV-VARIANT OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD (1:60) TO DIR-NAME ``` Provider Name Truncation to 60 Characters in Directory Output-L_WRITE-DIR-ROW: ```cobol MOVE PRV-VARIANT OF PRV-MASTER-RECORD (1:60) TO DIR-NAME ``` Write Formatted Provider Record to Nightly Provider Directory Flat File for MCOs-L_WRITE-DIR-ROW: ```cobol WRITE DIR-OUT-RECORD ``` Increment Provider Directory Row Count Upon Successful Record Write-L_WRITE-DIR-ROW: ```cobol ADD 1 TO WS-DIR-COUNT ```
